column1: Clarified that Stats cannot go below 0 (except HP).
PD and MD: New stats. They are inside factors for damage purposes (same as ATK / MAG).
column11: Frequency Cooldowns also follow this: can't use for 1 or 2 rounds.

column1: EVA: Became one stat. Removed the 9 EVA cap.
column8: Rounds are confusing! How do they work?

column1: MP: Now is a resource each turn.
column8: Many effects have "for X rounds" or similar in the effects.
First, Rounds are different from Turns.

column1: Damage rolls (XdY+Z) can have a negative "Z". For example, 2d8-3.
column9: Turns are limited to when each player can use (non-Reaction) actions.

column1: Trigger Actions: Now can only be used once per turn, but Trigger moves don't require a condition.
column9: Rounds are when all players' turns passes.

column1: Reactions (Timer): Removed the "next turn" part of it, and changed timer to 30 seconds.
column8: Second, Rounds are individual to each player.

column1: Tile: New targeting group. Used for altering tiles, or targeting foes in Splash range.
column9: If you and your opponent each use a "for one round" effect, they will end at different times.

column1: Splash: Now is AoE. Still hits/misses based on whether it hit the original target.
column8: When a "for X rounds" effect is used, they are active immediately.

column1: E3T: Renamed from E2T. No functional difference.
column8: Then, when that turn ends ends, now the countdown starts.

column1: Pierce: Full AoE range. Cannot be increased or decreased.
column8: So, 1 round effects last until the end of your next turn. 2 rounds last until the following round. etc.
(For damaging statuses, this means that you cannot keep an opponent permanently statused.)

column1: Ice Tiles: Now only considered foes when you attack them.

column2: Also doesn't have 15 HP, but instead breaks with 15 DMG.
column8: If you inflict a X round effect outside of your turn, it considers that entity's turn instead.

column9: So 1 round effects outside of your turn lasts until everyone's turn passes by.

column1: Buffs/Debuffs: Now always underlined or italicized. More effects can be buffs/debuffs.
Buffs/Debuffs to Stats: Not outside factors because they affects the stat directly.
Removed +DR. There is no equivalent of +DMG for Defense.
Basic Movement: Now is a proper Basic action (on the Homepage).
